gaia.service: ESA Gaia DR3 via the CDS VizieR mirror (ESA unavailable: fetch failed; positions propagated to the epoch)

gaiaQuery: SELECT TOP 50000 source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, parallax, parallax_error, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_variable_flag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL AND 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',246.726222,-24.410601,0.16))

simbad.main_id: NAME rho Oph Cloud IR Stellar Group

simbadQuery: SELECT TOP 10000 b.main_id,b.ra,b.dec,b.pmra,b.pmdec,b.otype,o.label AS otype_label FROM basic AS b LEFT JOIN otypedef AS o ON b.otype=o.otype WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',b.ra,b.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',246.726222,-24.410601,0.2))=1
